preconditions.description: n and m are within the specified range.
The number of forbidden prefix products matches n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in forbidden_prefix_products)
preconditions.description: All forbidden prefix products are within the range [0, m-1].
All forbidden prefix products are distinct.

postconditions.description: The length of the sequence k is within the range [0, m].
The length of the sequence matches k.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x < m for x in sequence)
postconditions.description: All elements in the sequence are within the range [0, m-1].
All elements in the sequence are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(prefix_product % m not in forbidden_prefix_products for prefix_product in prefix_products(sequence))
postconditions.description: No prefix product modulo m appears in the forbidden prefix products list.
All prefix products modulo m are distinct.
